map.可提高染料浓度、延长染色时间、适当升温，或使用匀染/渗透助剂；同时检查中和是否充: You can raise the dye concentration, extend the dyeing time, raise the temperature moderately, or use levelling and penetration auxiliaries; at the same time check whether neutralisation was sufficient and whether the skin fibres are too tightly packed.
map.大多数产品要求染透以避免切面白心，但某些特殊风格（如表面效应）并不追求全透；评级: Most products require dye penetration to avoid a white core at the cut, but some special styles (such as surface effects) do not aim for full penetration. Grading must also consider uniformity and colour fastness; penetration rate alone is not enough.

map.输入皮革染料的穿透深度与染色工艺参数，对照标准评定染色均匀度与质量等级，帮助制革: Enter the penetration depth of the leather dye and the dyeing process parameters, and grade the dyeing uniformity and quality against the standard, helping tanneries control colour uptake in the dyeing stage and reduce rework.
map.：厚 1.5 mm、穿透深度 1.35 mm：穿透率 = 1.35/1.5×10: : with a thickness of 1.5 mm and a penetration depth of 1.35 mm, the penetration rate = 1.35/1.5 x 100 = 90%; with uniformity 8 and colour fastness grade 4 this is a top-grade product. If the penetration depth is only 0.9 mm, the penetration rate is 60%, uniformity 6 and fastness 3, giving a first-grade product; below 50% it fails and the dye concentration or dyeing time must be increased.
map.：穿透率(%) = 穿透深度 ÷ 厚度 × 100%。等级判定（三项须同时满足）: : penetration rate (%) = penetration depth / thickness x 100%. Grade (all three must hold): penetration >= 90% with uniformity >= 8 and colour fastness >= grade 4 gives a top-grade product; >= 70% with >= 6 and >= 3 gives a first-grade product; >= 50% with >= 5 and >= 3 gives a qualified product; otherwise it fails. Refer to QB/T 4672, leather dyeing fastness measurement.
